_meta.description: kind: config. Overlays x-openregister-notifications rules onto the chained financial schemas now that they live on development. AR/AP rules attach to ARInvoice (in the monolith) and PurchaseOrder (declared by bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way-01-schemas-and-registers). APInvoice + PaymentRun rules were already published with the AP-core schemas. All subjects bilingual nl/en and metadata-only (invoice/PO number + dueDate). Recipients use object-acl/groups for AR/AP and the PurchaseOrder.requester uid field for PO. NOTE: the proposal referred to PurchaseOrder.status but the schema's actual lifecycle field is statusCode. Rule targets statusCode to match the live schema. FIX (semantic-invoice-consume Task 5, 2026-07-06): the ARInvoice rules were nested under components.ARInvoice. A sibling of components.schemas that OR's ImportHandler never reads (it iterates components.schemas only), so the block was dead config. Relocated under components.schemas.ARInvoice and modernised to the canonical dialect in the same batch: the old block filtered on a non-existent `state` field (ARInvoice's lifecycle field is `lifecycleState`, enum draft/issued/paid/overdue/disputed/written-off. `voided` does not exist) and used a non-canonical {all:[{field,operator,…}]} filter grammar with operators (notIn, before) the canonical scheduled-filter grammar (map of field → scalar equality or {operator: equals|notEquals|withinNext|olderThan, value}) does not know. The overdue reminder now filters lifecycleState=overdue. The lifecycle state that already encodes 'past due date, not paid/written-off'. And the paid rule conditions on lifecycleState equals paid.
